title: Clearing the chromatin roadblock: a dual strategy for H2A.Z depletion under high temperature
content: The global average temperature has risen significantly, with the last decade being the warmest on record (NOAA 2025). The climate crisis severely impacts plant growth. While we can hide in the shade, turn on the air conditioning, or jump into a pool when temperatures soar, how do plants and crops survive—and even thrive—on a planet that is undeniably getting warmer?
